instruction: Locate Half-Life 2 and add Episode One DLC to cart.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding Half-Life 2 in Steam store and adding Episode One DLC to cart. Uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric to verify cart content. Similar complexity to original Dota 2 task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly navigates to Steam cart page and extracts HTML content using get_page_info
Metric is_added_to_steam_cart correctly checks if 'Half-Life 2: Episode One' appears in cart page HTML
Complete coverage: instruction requires adding Episode One DLC to cart, evaluator verifies exactly that
Expected value 'Half-Life 2: Episode One' is the correct item name for the DLC
Practical implementation: getter has retry logic and 60-second timeout for robustness
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using case-insensitive matching or regex for more robust item name detection in case Steam's HTML formatting varies
Consider adding explicit wait for cart page to fully load dynamic content before extracting HTML
